evals.prompt: Generate the monthly links chart for the past year and save it to the project root.
evals.expected_output: A PNG file named links_monthly_chart.png is created in the project root. It is a bar chart with 12 bars (one per month) labelled with abbreviated month names, a y-axis showing link counts, a title, and axis labels.

evals.prompt: I want to see how many links were created each month this past year. Can you pull that data from the database and make a chart?
evals.expected_output: The skill reads DATABASE_URL from .env or .env.local, runs the plotting script, and saves a bar chart PNG. The assistant reports the output file path.

evals.prompt: Show me a bar chart of link creation activity over the last 12 months. Save the chart as my_links_chart.png in the tmp folder.
evals.expected_output: The skill produces tmp/my_links_chart.png. The chart has 12 monthly bars with counts, proper axis labels, a title, and no rendering errors.
